mainEntity.name: How do you handle the time zone gap with the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: We turn it into a follow-the-sun cycle: feedback you leave at the end of your day is in progress while you sleep, and a fresh demo build is usually ready before your next morning. We schedule live calls in your evening or our evening to keep a real overlap for scoping and reviews.

mainEntity.name: Can you build apps that comply with US regulations like HIPAA or SOC 2?

acceptedAnswer.text: We design data handling, audit trails and access control with your specific regulatory requirement in mind from day one — tell us which framework applies and we'll scope around it. We've built this kind of compliance-first architecture for regulated fintech platforms.

mainEntity.name: How much does a React Native app cost for a US founder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing isn't region-specific — it's driven by scope and complexity. Get an instant range with our app cost calculator, then a fixed-price proposal within 48 hours of a call.
Het Soni and senior engineers — no handoffs to juniors and no account managers between you and the people writing the code.
